title: Orthonormal basis of a finite-dimensional complex inner product space
statement: Let $E$ be a finite-dimensional complex inner product space, of complex dimension $n\geq0$ [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], over the usual complex field $\mathbf C$ [def-weil-field]. The inner product is conjugate-linear in its first argument and linear in its second, satisfies $\langle v,u\rangle=\overline{\langle u,v\rangle}$, and is positive definite; the norm is the compatible norm $\|v\|^2=\langle v,v\rangle$. There exists a complex vector-space basis $(b_j)_{1\leq j\leq n}$ of $E$ with $\langle b_j,b_k\rangle=\delta_{jk}$ for all $j,k$. For $n=0$ this is the empty basis.
